name: The Drowned Dockyard
description: Straight lines under the water, at what used to be a quayside.
arrival: The basin was cut square and lined with fired brick, and salt water has been in it long enough that a reef has taken the corners. Fish that have never seen the open sea live in a harbour that no longer reaches it.
notes: Lothal's dock. An archaeological site being eaten by an ecological one, which is the tone of the whole era.
